title: US Consumers Report an Estimated $17 Billion Spending at Small Businesses on 14th Annual Small Business Saturday This Year

facts.fact: According to the American Express 2023 Saturday Consumer Insights Survey, U.S. consumers' total reported projected spending at independent retailers and restaurants on Small Business Saturday 2023 (held November 25) reached an estimated $17 billion.
facts.quote: the total reported projected spending of U.S. consumers who shopped at independent retailers and restaurants on Small Business Saturday

facts.fact: American Express reports that total reported spend at U.S. small businesses during Small Business Saturday has reached an estimated $201 billion since the event was created in 2010.
facts.quote: total reported spend at small businesses during the annual Small Business Saturday in the U.S. has reached an estimated $201 billion

facts.fact: American Express has a stated goal of reaching $100 billion in consumer spending at small, independently owned retailers or restaurants on Small Business Saturday and other Shop Small campaigns from 2021 through 2025.
facts.quote: our goal to reach $100 billion in spending by consumers at small, independently owned retailers or restaurants on Small Business Saturday and during other Shop Small campaigns from 2021 through 2025

facts.fact: The American Express-cited 2022 Small Business Economic Impact Study estimated that if every Gen Z and Millennial shopper spent $10 at a small business on Small Business Saturday, it would support $2 billion in U.S. local economic activity.
facts.quote: if every Gen Z and Millennial shopper spent $10 at a small business on Small Business Saturday, it would support $2 billion in local economic activity throughout the U.S.

facts.fact: The 2022 Small Business Economic Impact Study found that $0.68 of every dollar spent at a U.S. small business stays in the local community.
facts.quote: $0.68 of every dollar spent at a small business in the U.S. stays in the local community

facts.fact: The 2022 Small Business Economic Impact Study found that every dollar spent at small businesses creates an additional $0.48 in local business activity.
facts.quote: every dollar spent at small businesses creates an additional $0.48 in local business activity

facts.fact: In the American Express 2023 Saturday Consumer Insights Survey, 59% of U.S. consumers aware of Small Business Saturday shopped or ate at a small, independently owned retailer or restaurant on Small Business Saturday 2023.
facts.quote: 59% of U.S. consumers aware of Small Business Saturday shopped or ate at a small, independently owned retailer or restaurant on Small Business Saturday this year

facts.fact: Small Business Saturday 2023 in the U.S. took place on November 25.
facts.quote: which took place on November 25 this year

facts.fact: Small Business Saturday in the U.K. was scheduled to begin on December 2 (2023).
facts.quote: Small Business Saturday in the U.K. will begin on December 2.

facts.fact: A related TSG article headlined 'Visa and Mastercard Report 4% Growth in US Holiday Retail Sales' was published December 24, 2025, and reports 4% growth attributed to Visa and Mastercard, not to this page's author.
facts.quote: ### Visa and Mastercard Report 4% Growth in US Holiday Retail Sales
